goal: Test prospective consolidation (two-tier, innovation-whitened per-parameter gains) against tuned AdamW and the retained polar frontier, with uniform-gain and scalar-gain controls.
diagnosis: Adam's first/second moments summarize within-block gradient statistics; when a block reuses one batch (8 epochs) or is a single sample, cross-block persistence of realized displacements is unobserved. The consolidation gain reads it per parameter from lag-1 innovation autocorrelation.
model: Same 17-64-64-1 tanh MLP and initialization API as previous dense proxy. CUDA FP32, TF32 off; compiled updates and captured repeated-epoch rounds. No covariance or Fisher state.
moving_task: Eight equal segments interpolate through independently drawn nonlinear teachers; input mean shifts smoothly. No task ID, teacher, clean targets or noise variance enters optimizer. Targets/action rewards are noisy. Changes occur in full rounds so old PPO logprobs/advantages remain frozen within reuse epochs.
bandit: Gaussian scalar policy with fixed std=.5; noisy reward=-(action-teacher(context))^2+N(0,1); advantages use only same-round sampled reward minus round mean. Real signed clipped PPO score with clip=.2, no critic, no advantage normalization. New on-policy actions each round, common base noise across candidates. This is a policy-optimization proxy, NOT MuJoCo or a claim of PPO ranking validity.

equations.tier: block of `block` fast steps (AdamW or polar) from phi; at boundary d = z - phi (- vel); c = g c + (1-g) d d_prev; nu = g nu + (1-g) d^2; K = clamp(K exp(eta c/nu), kmin, 1); phi' = z - (1-K) d; vel' = vg vel + (1-vg)(phi'-phi) (vel arm only); z <- phi'.
equations.look_adamw: eta = 0: uniform Lookahead with alpha = k0 over the same blocks (control for the two-tier structure without adaptation).
equations.scalar_adamw: one K per candidate adapted from the parameter-mean of c/nu (control: time profile kept, spatial dispersion erased).
equations.adamw: C=0; ordinary bias-corrected AdamW, beta2 tuned, decoupled decay excludes bias columns in every family. Adam is the decay=0 subset.
equations.polar: retained v8 five-step polar; hidden matrices Newton-Schulz, biases/head AdamW.

selection: adamw/polar reuse the 2036 v8 configurations. Tier families fix beta1/beta2/weight_decay/head_lr_scale to their fast tier's v8-locked confirmation configuration for the regime and sweep the full 13-point lr axis times tier axes (52 configs; look_adamw 39). One family per job.
heldout: Independent train/validation/test RNG namespaces under seed1, no extra-seed claims. Noisy validation observed independently, clean risk diagnostic only. Held-out scoring after locks over saved selected trajectories; test scores never rerank configurations. Adaptive development rounds must be labelled, not disguised as untouched confirmation.
diagnostics: Retain16equal right-endpoint checkpoints; sustained risk is a quadrature estimate, not continuous measurement. Heldout deployment-gradient diagnostics at preupdate weights include clipping/reuse/same-batch-baseline discrepancy in bandit, not pure noise. No confidence acrosstrainingseeds. Save locked selected trajectories, prune only generated unselected grid tensors after all selected writes and scores complete. Tier families log per-candidate gain mean/std per checkpoint.
promotion: Seek >=20% lower sustained held-out excess risk than independently tuned AdamW, no substantial regression in other regimes, and account for extra gradient evaluations/runtime. This is an experimental target, not a promised result. No RL promotion from one proxy win. Additionally the adaptive arms must beat both look_adamw and scalar_adamw at their own tuned configurations, or the gain is a level/structure effect.

execution.culling: No short-horizon culling of a full comparative stream; nonfinite candidates invalidated visibly. No blind retries.

state: Tier families add six per-parameter slots (phi, K, c, nu, previous innovation, velocity); no covariance or Fisher state.
